purpose: Assess whether the separately versioned stable primitive arithmetic repairs the complete constructor/pre_mesh boundary while retaining unchanged native topology, ordering and caches and exposing any remaining whole-mesh geometric defects.

boundary.entry: An authenticated betse_initial_mesh_preparation.Request plus an explicit exact new-law opt-in token.
boundary.exit: Complete constructor and pre_mesh caches/events or a retained partial failure. Before clipping, refinement, operators or physical adapter admission.
boundary.original_flags: Keep authenticated caller flags unchanged, including allow_merging, rect/tri mesh type, alpha filtering and centroid selection. No rewritten caller recipes.
boundary.input_conversion: Only original float64 point arrays cross the adapter, preserving their input bits, row order and dimensions. Explicit float64-to-Python-float copies feed stable primitive requests. Returned scalars are converted to the original NumPy float64 scalar/tuple interface.
boundary.primitive_refusals: Repeated, non-simple, degenerate, out-of-range or unresolved primitive inputs retain their trial and stop this mesh. No point deduplication, canonicalization, jitter, alternate triangulation or fallback to native arithmetic is added.

source_equivalence_lane.claim: Conditional source equivalence given the supplied repaired primitive scalar values or refusals, never exact native arithmetic equivalence.
source_equivalence_lane.method: Compile the original pinned 17-method native closure. Replace exactly three primitive bodies with a tape call. Authenticate exact typed call argument signatures, including scalar/array types, bits, shape, strides and container order, before consuming each saved output/refusal. All other native AST bodies remain unchanged.
source_equivalence_lane.comparisons: Every original event after filtering only the extra primitive-repair events, complete constructor/final caches, original return types, source ordering, deletion indices and source occurrence IDs, all full MT19937 words/position/cached Gaussian state and warnings.
source_equivalence_lane.constructor_kwargs: Only the outer keyword map is compared by exact key set and exact per-value typed signature. This does not relax cache, event or nested container ordering.
source_equivalence_lane.failures: Retain both complete raw failures. Qhull transient reason text is excluded only from typed top-level failure-payload comparison; every other member stays exact. Unexpected primitive failure types cannot be replayed as accepted tape values.
source_equivalence_lane.fresh_process: Deny Cells, BETSE, JAX, Torch and Pillow before native provider import. NumPy/SciPy are available to execute pinned original source in the isolated namespace.

independent_geometry_lane.arithmetic: Standard-library integer-grid predicates and Decimal only, reusing the pinned independent primitive definition and certificate comparison code. No production geometry calls or native arithmetic formulas supply mathematical targets.
independent_geometry_lane.repairs: Recompute every recorded primitive from exact supplied input bits at both independent precision levels; check all 32-ULP certificates and unchanged fixed budgets, output adapter bits, request/result digests and full precision targets.
independent_geometry_lane.whole_mesh: Independently check primal triangles/retained quads and all supplied dual polygons, signed areas/centroids, circumcentres/radii, fourth-vertex circle membership for retained quads, endpoint-derived lengths/midpoints/tangents, exact supplied coordinate ownership and mathematical edge/face/vertex incidence.
independent_geometry_lane.geometric_invariants: Independently check simple positive rings, exact oriented interior edge cancellation, incidence multiplicity, boundary degrees, boundary/face Green-area balance, boundary intersections and disjoint polygon interiors. Check full primal convex-hull coverage only when alpha filtering is disabled; otherwise use the retained-complex boundary and retain holes.
independent_geometry_lane.dual_mapping: Treat native vor_edges as a selected subset of the complete dual polygon edge complex. Do not require the stored subset to contain every exterior edge. Check membership, duplicate selected edges and the paired primal-edge incident-centre/reflection geometry independently; retain nearest-midpoint and orientation-flip source behavior unchanged.
independent_geometry_lane.delaunay: Exact integer empty-circle and cocircular-tie diagnostics on supplied original simplices. No independent topology generation and no canonical Qhull tie-order claim. Any strict geometric violation remains visible.
independent_geometry_lane.signed_zero: Mathematical coordinate/incidence checks identify +0 and -0; the typed source replay still distinguishes their bits.
independent_geometry_lane.precision: Primitive references use their frozen adaptive max(4096,6*input decimal span+160) digit policy and +512-digit refinement. Whole-mesh distances/moments use 4096 and 4608 digits. Retain both full reports before comparing.
independent_geometry_lane.fresh_process: Deny Cells, BETSE, SciPy, JAX, Torch and Pillow before reference provider import. NumPy is used only by the independent typed archive transport; the mathematical module itself has no scientific-package imports.
independent_geometry_lane.scope: Checking the supplied complete mesh is not topology generation, global topology qualification or biological/physical geometry admission.

tolerances.primitive: Frozen 32-ULP certificate policy and unchanged 1e-27 + 6e-12*abs(full precision reference), with area floor 1e-26.
tolerances.reference_resolution: At most 0.1 of each fixed budget; primitive comparison also requires at most 0.01 ULP.
tolerances.integer_geometry: Exact signs, equalities and incidence on supplied finite binary64 coordinates. No snapping or topology tolerance.
tolerances.failure_policy: A remaining native quad, mapping, topology or geometric defect leaves this candidate open. Keep all original failures, budgets and input recipes; no selective case removal or relabelling as native accuracy.

controls.B09: Reuse the four originally admitted B09 inputs only. merged-square-aux remains refused by the unchanged physical adapter before construction; the separate constructor-only B09 adapter is not used.

ownership: New Request and State exact types and identities; immutable inherited typed cache snapshots. Per-call stable requests/results/certificates, raw adapter outputs and failure trials are owned by the event ledger. No registration into the physical adapter or default native path.
artifact_policy: Durable actual buffers and outcomes before any source/reference assertions. All declared units are bounded and distinct. Continue the predeclared panel after ordinary assertion failures to retain the complete verdict; stop on resource, cleanup, startup or collection failures. No retry. Finalize one bounded metadata record at a time, including failed scientific assertions and partial results. Root owns the mandatory external startup-failure wrapper and any detached launch.
